newsitem.title: TAIWAN: TAIWAN STOCKS - factors to watch - August 15.
newsitem.headline: TAIWAN STOCKS - factors to watch - August 15.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Taiwan stocks on Friday:
* Benchmark stock index is expected to continue Thursday's rebound to rise.
* Index rebounded 0.80 percent/76.22 points to close at 9,632.34 on Thursday.
* Wall Street and Nasdaq rose overnight.
* Albert Lin, research chief, Golden Securities: "Thursday's rebound likely will continue today as electronics should lead the gains boosted by Wall Street and Nasdaq overnight gains."

* Government to release second-quarter gross domestic product growth around 17.00 (0900 GMT). A Reuters poll on economists forecast a 5.81 percent year-on-year growth, higher than the government's May forecast of 5.61 percent.

* The cabinet on Thursday approved a "two-into-one" tax merger proposal, setting the merged rate at 25 percent, to boost the island's investment and economy, which has been slowing in recent quarters.
